en.restingFace: a warm, chatty smile with a hint of teeth, eyebrows relaxed and slightly lifted, eyes locked on the lens like talking to one friend
en.emphasisBeat: on every stressed word or number the eyes widen, the eyebrows pop up, and the mouth opens bigger for about half a second, then the face relaxes back into the smile
en.hookBeat: eyebrows already lifting into a big warm smile
en.ctaBeat: a softer, closer smile, eyebrows settling, the torso leaning a little toward the lens like sharing a secret
en.gestureLibrary: a raised index finger or a small finger count on a list or a number, an open palm pushed out toward the lens on 'look at this', a palm facing the lens swaying side to side on a negative, fingers spread beside the face on a big claim, a palm turned up and offered to the lens on an invitation
en.headMotion: a constant small side-to-side sway of a few degrees, tilts left and right, nods on stressed words, a chin drop then lift, a small lean in on the key point then settling back; shoulders rock
en.anchorProp: a small homemade microphone — a thin stick with a fluffy fuzzy windscreen — held near the mouth
en.set: the same real sitting spot in every clip, seated beside a bookshelf, books at the shoulder
en.light: soft natural indoor daylight, ordinary and unchanged, like a phone video at home

yue.restingFace: 露少少牙嘅親切笑容，眉毛放鬆微微揚起，直望鏡頭好似同一個朋友傾偈
yue.emphasisBeat: 每到重音字或者數字，眼睛睜大、眉毛快速上挑、口張大約半秒，然後放鬆返落笑容
yue.hookBeat: 眉毛已經揚起、展開一個大笑容
yue.ctaBeat: 更柔和、更親近嘅淺笑，眉毛放鬆，上身微微傾向鏡頭好似講緊秘密
yue.gestureLibrary: 數數或者講數字時豎食指、「睇呢個」時掌心向鏡頭推出、否定時掌心對鏡頭左右擺、誇張強調時五指張開喺臉旁、邀請時掌心向上遞向鏡頭
yue.headMotion: 全程有幾度嘅細幅左右搖擺，頭左右傾、重音位點頭、下巴跌一跌再抬起，講到重點時微微前傾再坐返；膊頭郁
yue.anchorProp: 一支自製咪（幼棒加毛毛防風罩）靠近個口
yue.set: 全程同一個真實坐位，坐喺書架旁邊，身後係書
yue.light: 柔和自然室內日光，似喺屋企用手機拍，不變
